title: Error registering Shift key in Godot Engine 4.7.2
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Engine 4.7.2 stable.mono (C#)

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot Engine 4.7.2 stable.mono (C#) - Render: Mobile - Igpu - Intel Core i5-13420H 13th Gen - 16Gb Ram

### Issue description

Hello,

There is probably a bug in my project or in the **Game Engine**. I am using **Godot Engine 4.7.2 stable.mono (C#)**.

**3D Game**

I noticed an issue registering the Shift key. In my game I use Shift to sprint. When I hold W + Shift, the character starts sprinting. When I release Shift, it should return to normal walking, but sometimes the engine still detects Shift as pressed, so the character continues sprinting only when holding W.

For comparison, I also tested the Ctrl key, which works correctly.

I tested the issue on multiple keyboards, so I think the issue may be on the Godot Engine side or its keyboard input processing.

Interestingly, the:
`Input.is_action_pressed("sprint")`

does not behave correctly, while the direct check:
`Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT)`

works correctly.

Please check if this is not a problem with the Shift key handling in **Godot Engine 4.7.2**.

Thank you. Homebax Studios

### Steps to reproduce

1. Project -> Project settings -> Input Map -> Add new action "sprint"
2. Add event "sprint" - Key Shift
3. GDScript `Input.is_action_pressed("sprint")`
4. Play. When playing, it happens about 20% of the time that the Engine thinks I'm holding "Shift" but the console displays the Shift behavior correctly but the game doesn't.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

# Player_Movement.gd:

> The notes are in my language (Czech)


```
extends Node


# ==================================================
# MOVEMENT
# ==================================================

@export_category("Movement")

@export var walk_speed: float = 2.5
@export var run_speed: float = 5.0
@export var sprint_speed: float = 8.0


# ==================================================
# ACCELERATION
# ==================================================

@export_category("Acceleration")

@export var acceleration: float = 15.0
@export var deceleration: float = 35.0


# ==================================================
# GRAVITY
# ==================================================

@export_category("Gravity")

@export var gravity: float = 9.8
@export var jump_velocity: float = 5.0


# ==================================================
# ROTATION
# ==================================================

@export_category("Rotation")

@export var rotation_speed: float = 12.0


# ==================================================
# UPDATE MOVEMENT
# ==================================================

func update_movement(
	player: CharacterBody3D,
	camera_pivot: Node3D,
	delta: float
) -> void:


	# ==================================================
	# GRAVITY
	# ==================================================

	if not player.is_on_floor():

		player.velocity.y -= gravity * delta

	else:

		if player.velocity.y < 0.0:
			player.velocity.y = -0.5


	# ==================================================
	# JUMP
	# ==================================================

	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump"):

		if player.is_on_floor():

			player.velocity.y = jump_velocity


	# ==================================================
	# INPUT
	# ==================================================

	var input_vector := Input.get_vector(
		"move_left",
		"move_right",
		"move_backward",
		"move_forward"
	)


	# ==================================================
	# CAMERA DIRECTION
	# ==================================================

	var camera_forward := -camera_pivot.global_transform.basis.z
	var camera_right := camera_pivot.global_transform.basis.x


	camera_forward.y = 0.0
	camera_right.y = 0.0


	if camera_forward.length_squared() > 0.001:
		camera_forward = camera_forward.normalized()

	if camera_right.length_squared() > 0.001:
		camera_right = camera_right.normalized()


	# ==================================================
	# MOVEMENT DIRECTION
	# ==================================================

	var direction := (
		camera_right * input_vector.x
		+
		camera_forward * input_vector.y
	)


	if direction.length() > 1.0:
		direction = direction.normalized()


	# ==================================================
	# SPEED
	# ==================================================

	var is_moving := input_vector.length() > 0.01

	var is_sprinting := Input.is_action_pressed("sprint")

	var speed := 0.0


	if is_moving:

		if is_sprinting:

			speed = sprint_speed

		else:

			speed = walk_speed


	# ==================================================
	# TARGET VELOCITY
	# ==================================================

	var target_velocity := direction * speed


	var horizontal_velocity := Vector3(
		player.velocity.x,
		0.0,
		player.velocity.z
	)


	# ==================================================
	# ACCELERATION
	# ==================================================

	if direction.length() > 0.01:

		horizontal_velocity = horizontal_velocity.move_toward(
			target_velocity,
			acceleration * delta
		)


	# ==================================================
	# DECELERATION
	# ==================================================

	else:

		horizontal_velocity = horizontal_velocity.move_toward(
			Vector3.ZERO,
			deceleration * delta
		)


		# ----------------------------------------------
		# Remove tiny movement
		# ----------------------------------------------

		if horizontal_velocity.length() < 0.05:

			horizontal_velocity = Vector3.ZERO


	# ==================================================
	# APPLY VELOCITY
	# ==================================================

	player.velocity.x = horizontal_velocity.x
	player.velocity.z = horizontal_velocity.z


	# ==================================================
	# ROTATION
	# ==================================================

	if Input.is_action_pressed("camera_aim"):

		# ----------------------------------------------
		# RMB / AIM
		# ----------------------------------------------

		# Pokud se hráč POHYBUJE,
		# otáčíme ho podle kamery.

		if direction.length() > 0.01:

			var forward := -camera_pivot.global_transform.basis.z

			forward.y = 0.0


			if forward.length_squared() > 0.001:

				forward = forward.normalized()


				var target_angle := atan2(
					forward.x,
					forward.z
				)


				player.rotation.y = lerp_angle(
					player.rotation.y,
					target_angle,
					rotation_speed * delta
				)


		# ----------------------------------------------
		# RMB + STÁNÍ
		# ----------------------------------------------
		#
		# TADY NIC NEDĚLÁME.
		#
		# Turn Left / Right řeší Player.gd.
		# ----------------------------------------------


	elif direction.length() > 0.01:

		# ----------------------------------------------
		# NORMAL MOVEMENT
		# ----------------------------------------------

		var target_angle := atan2(
			direction.x,
			direction.z
		)


		player.rotation.y = lerp_angle(
			player.rotation.y,
			target_angle,
			rotation_speed * delta
		)

```
